test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A hollow cylindrical tube made of plastic is 3 cm thick. If the external diameter is 20 cm and length of the tube is 49 cm, find the volume of the plastic.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume of a hollow tube** = π × h × (R + r) × (R − r)

Here, R = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm, r = 10 − 3 = 7 cm, and h = 49 cm.

Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 49 × (10 + 7) × (10 − 7)

Volume = 22 × 7 × 17 × 3 = 154 × 51 = 7854 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 7854 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**External diameter** (D) = 20 cm

**Thickness** of the tube = 3 cm

**Length** of the tube (h) = 49 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bcfaf45c592e87a7dcee460a479970475ef195eab6f3e67ee93b9eaa5b6317b.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of plastic** = π × (R² − r²) × h

Where R = **External Radius** and r = **Internal Radius**.

**Calculations:**

⇒ External Radius (R) = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

⇒ Internal Radius (r) = External Radius − Thickness

⇒ r = 10 − 3 = 7 cm

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (10² − 7²) × 49

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (100 − 49) × 49

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 51 × 49

⇒ Volume = 22 × 51 × 7

⇒ Volume = 1122 × 7

⇒ Volume = 7854 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 7854 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Solid Cylinder

The volume is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Total Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

TSA = 2πRh + 2πrh + 2π(R² − r²), which includes outer CSA, inner CSA, and the area of two rings at the ends.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

For a solid cylinder, CSA = 2πrh. For a hollow cylinder, the total CSA is the sum of inner and outer surfaces: 2πh(R + r).</p
